positions.name: Bent three · side · enclosed
positions.notes: {{SQ:T16,T15,S15|The 3-point eye space}}. {{CR:T15|The bend}} is the vital point.

extra.XSUM: Three points with a bend. Like straight three, the point in the middle of the bend decides the result.
extra.XSRC: Sensei's Library (senseis.xmp.net): KillableEyeshapes and the shape's own page. Results checked with a small life-and-death search.

moves.why: Takes the vital point. {{SQ:T16}} and {{SQ:S15}} become two separate eyes.
Leaves {{SQ:T16,T15|a two-point space}}, which is only one eye.
